fullDescription: Dark glassmorphic FAQ / help-center page: aurora-lit ink canvas, frosted-glass accordion rows grouped by category with one pre-expanded aqua-glow row, sticky blurred nav and a gradient contact CTA.

structured.summary: A dark, glassmorphic FAQ / help-center page on an aurora-lit near-black canvas. A single centered column of frosted-glass accordion rows is grouped into labeled categories (General, Pricing & Credits, Privacy & Support), with one row pre-expanded in an aqua-tinted active state. A sticky blurred nav sits on top and a gradient 'Talk to us' contact CTA card closes the page.

style.description: Premium dark glassmorphism: a near-black ink base (#0b0f14) lit by soft blurred aurora blobs (aqua #2dd4bf top-left, magenta #e879f9 bottom-right, sky/indigo #7dd3fc/#6366f1 mid), a faint radial vignette and a 4%-opacity SVG film grain over the top. Surfaces are translucent frosted glass (white 6%->2.5% vertical gradient, 1px white/9% border, backdrop-blur 18px, inset top highlight + soft drop shadow). The active accordion uses an aqua->magenta tinted glass with an aqua/30 border and an aqua glow shadow. Type pairs Space Grotesk (display: headings, nav wordmark, category labels) with Inter (body/UI). Accent color is the aqua->sky->magenta gradient, used for the headline highlight word, category dividers, the logo mark and the CTA button. Corners are generous (rounded-2xl cards, rounded-full chips/buttons), spacing is airy and centered.
style.prompt: Design a premium dark glassmorphism aesthetic. Base background ink #0b0f14. Paint a fixed aurora field behind everything: a large aqua blob (#2dd4bf, ~70% opacity, blur 100px) anchored top-left, a magenta blob (#e879f9, ~62% opacity) bottom-right, and a softer sky/indigo blob (#7dd3fc -> #6366f1, ~50% opacity, blur 120px) mid-upper-center; overlay a radial vignette darkening the edges to rgba(11,15,20,.85) and a 4%-opacity fractal-noise SVG grain. All surfaces are frosted glass: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(255,255,255,.06), rgba(255,255,255,.025)), 1px rgba(255,255,255,.09) border, backdrop-filter blur(18px), box-shadow inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.08) and 0 18px 40px -24px rgba(0,0,0,.8). Active/open glass shifts to linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(45,212,191,.10), rgba(232,121,249,.05)) with a 1px rgba(45,212,191,.30) border and an aqua glow shadow. Fonts: Space Grotesk (weights 500/600/700) for display/headings, Inter (400-700) for body. Body text slate-200/400, headings white. Accent gradient linear-gradient(92deg, #2dd4bf 0%, #7dd3fc 40%, #e879f9 100%) for the headline highlight word, category divider lines, logo mark and primary CTA. Corners rounded-2xl on cards, rounded-full on chips/buttons. Keep layout centered, airy and high-contrast.

layout_and_structure.description: Sticky blurred top nav, then a single centered max-w-3xl column: a centered eyebrow chip + gradient headline + sub-line, then three FAQ category groups (each = an icon + uppercase tracked label + fading divider line, followed by a vertical stack of glass accordion rows), with one row pre-opened, and a full-width glass contact-CTA card at the bottom.

prompts.prompt: A sticky top header (z-40) with nav-glass styling: background rgba(11,15,20,.55), backdrop-blur 16px, 1px bottom border rgba(255,255,255,.06). Inside, a mx-auto max-w-6xl row, 64px tall (h-16), px-6, items vertically centered, space-between. Left: logo = an 8x8 rounded-lg tile with an aqua->magenta gradient holding a ph:sparkle-fill icon in ink color, next to a Space Grotesk 700 white wordmark 'Superdesign' (17px). Center (hidden below md): nav links 'Prompts / Canvas / Pricing / FAQ' in slate-300, with the active 'FAQ' link in white. Right: a text 'Sign in' link (slate-300, hidden on small) and a solid white rounded-full 'Start free' pill button with ink text.

Centered header block, mb-12. Top: an inline rounded-full glass chip (background rgba(45,212,191,.10), 1px rgba(45,212,191,.22) border) containing a ph:question-fill icon and the label 'HELP CENTER' in aqua, 12px, weight 600, tracked. Below (mt-5): an h1 in Space Grotesk 700, white, text-4xl/sm:text-5xl, tight leading, reading 'Questions, answered.' where the word 'answered.' uses the aqua->sky->magenta gradient text clip. Below (mt-4): a slate-400 sub-paragraph, max-w-md, centered: 'Everything about generating UI from a prompt, the canvas, and shipping designs fast. Still stuck? Ping us, we'll sort it together.'

Repeat this group three times (mb-10). Header row: an icon (aqua ph:compass-fill / magenta ph:credit-card-fill / aqua ph:shield-check-fill), an h2 category label in Space Grotesk 600, uppercase, 14px, letter-spacing 0.14em, colored to match the icon (aqua or magenta), then a 1px divider line that fades from accent/30 to transparent (bg-gradient-to-r). Below it a vertical stack (space-y-3) of accordion rows. Categories: 'General', 'Pricing & Credits', 'Privacy & Support'.

A native <details> glass card, rounded-2xl. Summary row: flex space-between, px-6 py-5, with the question text (Inter 600, 15.5px, slate-100, brightening to white on hover) on the left and on the right a 32px (h-8 w-8) rounded-full chevron button (bg white/5, 1px white/10 border) holding a ph:caret-down-bold icon in slate-300. List marker hidden. The answer region is collapsed (max-height 0, opacity 0).

Pre-open one row (the 'Who is Superdesign built for?' row) using glass-open styling: aqua->magenta tinted glass, 1px rgba(45,212,191,.30) border, aqua glow shadow. Its question text is white; its chevron button has an aqua/15 fill, aqua/30 border, a soft aqua ring-dot glow (box-shadow 0 0 0 4px rgba(45,212,191,.12)), and the caret icon is aqua and rotated 180deg. The answer body is revealed (max-height ~320px, opacity 1) with a slate-300 paragraph separated by a top hairline border in aqua/15, pt-4.

prompts.prompt: A full-width glass card, rounded-2xl, px-6 py-7, flex column on mobile / row on sm with space-between. Left: an 11x11 rounded-xl tile with an aqua/20->magenta/20 gradient and white/10 border holding a ph:chats-circle-fill icon in aqua, beside a two-line block: 'Still have a question?' (white, 600) and 'We're friendly, fast, and actually human.' (slate-400, sm). Right: a rounded-full primary button with an aqua->magenta gradient fill and ink text reading 'Talk to us' followed by a ph:arrow-up-right-bold icon.

special_ui_components.prompt: Aurora background field: three blurred radial-gradient blobs (aqua #2dd4bf, magenta #e879f9, sky/indigo #7dd3fc->#6366f1) + radial vignette + 4% SVG fractal-noise grain layer
Frosted-glass accordion card with distinct closed (white-tint) vs open (aqua->magenta tint, aqua glow + ring-dot chevron) states, built on native <details>/<summary>
Animated chevron: rounded-pill icon button that rotates 180deg and turns aqua when its row opens; answer reveals via max-height/opacity transition
Category section header: accent icon + uppercase tracked Space Grotesk label + horizontal divider line that fades accent->transparent
Gradient text headline (aqua->sky->magenta clip) and gradient pill CTA + gradient logo mark sharing the same accent ramp
Sticky translucent blurred nav bar (nav-glass) with a solid white 'Start free' pill

structured.special_notes: Single centered max-w-3xl reading column on a max-w-6xl nav. Accent ramp is consistently aqua #2dd4bf -> sky #7dd3fc -> magenta #e879f9 on the ink #0b0f14 base. Exactly one accordion row should ship pre-expanded to show the active glass treatment. Icons are Phosphor (ph:*) via Iconify. Responsive: nav links collapse below md and 'Sign in' hides on small; the CTA card stacks vertically on mobile. No em-dashes in copy; voice is warm and human (e.g. 'we'll sort it together').
